items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I tried to show him for 6 long months, Milt, how to play vibraphones

ctx.x: ... I'll think in this period we'll try to mention some of your friends that you know.

There was one drummer that could have been and should have been. That was Jesse Price. Just straight jazz. I tried to show him for 6 long months, Milt, how to play vibraphones, "Trees", just "Trees" in the key of B-flat. He'd fix pork chops and eggs for me and I'd be laying on the bed and telling him what note to hit. He was just too thick - we called him "Country" but he's a beautiful man and a natural. When you speak about the musical drummers, the top great musical drummer I knew was a fellow by the name of…
You mean Roy Eldridge started on drums?
